patterns.note: The hero section features a multi-stage, scroll-triggered animation that transforms large-scale text and custom illustrations, creating a dynamic narrative as the user scrolls.
Alternating light and dark background sections are used to visually segment content, creating clear breaks and a sense of progression down the page.
The site employs extremely large, expressive display serif fonts for primary headlines, often integrated with playful, hand-drawn graphic elements, contrasting with a clean sans-serif for body text.
A consistent palette of warm off-white, deep charcoal, and a vibrant golden yellow accent is used across all sections, creating a cohesive and branded feel.
Feature lists are presented as card-like elements with subtle shadows and a distinctive vertical accent bar on the left edge, providing visual structure and emphasis.

technique_notes: The hero animation system uses a Lottie-driven, scroll-linked sequence to progressively transform the main illustration and headline text, creating a dynamic, narrative reveal as the user scrolls through the initial viewport.
Content sections are introduced with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement without distracting from the content.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, high-contrast serif headings (~5-10x body text) with a playful, almost handwritten character, paired with clean, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card elements (e.g., 8-12px).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; the hero section is particularly airy, while content sections maintain comfortable padding.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly expressive and dynamic hero section, which uses a narrative-driven, scroll-triggered animation to transform large-scale typography and custom illustrations. This creates a playful yet sophisticated brand identity that feels unique and engaging, moving beyond typical static hero imagery.
